F. Effect Upon Section 4(f) Land
A temporary construction easement will be required from the Forest Preserve District of Cook County for the removal of the bridge wingwalls from the existing bridge over Thorn Creek and to provide a safer grade for the entrance driveway into the Forest Preserve District site. In accordance with provisions and agreement for the temporary use of Forest Preserve District land, the Department of Transportation will return the area used back to the Forest Preserve in its original condition or better.
Previously in the same area, on Forest Preserve property contiguous to the land to be used for temporary construction, the Department of Transportation also agreed to build a parking lot and pedestrian foot bridge over Thorn Creek. The parking lot and foot bridge construction was completed in the late Fall of 1971.
G. Displacement of People and Businesses
A total of eight structures will be demolished, due to right-of-way acquisition requirements. Of the eight buildings, six are commercial business structures and two are residential structures.
The area of improvement is located where replacement housing or land of comparable market value is available. The few buildings and houses affected will not significantly alter the existing housing market. The State's Relocation Assistance and Payments Program is available to all people who desire relocation due to the construction of this project.
Right-of-way acquisition will be in accordance with the provisions of the Uniform Relocation Assistance and Real Property Acquisition Policies Act of 1970 and subsequent directives and guidelines issued by the Federal Highway Administration.
